question: In November 2021, which of the following dancer won a Padma Shri for the contribution in Arts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manjamma Jogati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manjamma Jogathi, is an Indian Kannada theatre actress, singer, and dancer of Jogathi Nritya, a folk dance form of North Karnataka.
 
• In 2019, she became the first transgender woman to be the president of Karnataka Janapada Academy, the state's top institution for folk arts.
 
• She was born on 20 May 1957.
 
• A folk dance is a dance that reflects the life of the people of a certain country or region.
 
• Not all ethnic dances are folk dances. For example, ritual dances or dances of ritual origin are not considered to be folk dances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Padma Awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.__ This is one of the highest civilian honours of India.
 
• Padma Awards were started in the year 1954.
 
• The highest civilian award of India is Bharat Ratna which is awarded to a maximum of 3 awardees in a particular year.
